national_news.title: India's Economy Moving Ahead as Fastest-Growing Major Economy: President Droupadi Murmu
bullets: India's economy is expected to grow more than twice the average global growth rate.
The 'Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan' has strengthened the foundation of the country's economic progress and national security.
President Droupadi Murmu highlighted India's economic progress on the eve of the 80th Independence Day.

national_news.title: India Reiterates Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh as Integral Parts of the Country
bullets: India reaffirmed that Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an inalienable and integral part of the country.
External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal highlighted atrocities in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir and cross-border terrorism.
India has had several engagements with Afghanistan in the last few months, including Ministerial visits.

national_news.title: Delhi court allows CBI to conduct further investigation in NEET-UG paper leak case
bullets: A Delhi court has allowed the CBI to conduct further investigation in the NEET UG Paper leak case.
New evidence has surfaced during the investigation, prompting the CBI to seek permission to keep the case open.
The court has allowed the CBI to investigate other conspirators in the case, in addition to the 13 accused persons already charged.

national_news.title: NTA to release provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET and ICAR-NET 2026
bullets: NTA to publish provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, and ICAR AIEEA (PG) and AICE (PhD) 2026
Examination determines eligibility for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), Assistant Professor appointment, and PhD programme admission
Candidates advised to rely only on official communications from NTA regarding examinations and answer keys

national_news.title: PM Internship Scheme aims to bridge industry-skill gap
bullets: The scheme is designed to bridge the gap between industry expectations and the skills of candidates.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and is open to those in the 18-25 age group.
The interns receive benefits under the scheme, although details are not specified in the article.

national_news.title: Romania Begins Shutdown of Second Cernavoda Nuclear Reactor Amid Severe Drought
bullets: Romania has begun a controlled shutdown of the second reactor at its Cernavoda nuclear power plant.
The shutdown is due to severe drought affecting much of Europe, pushing the Danube River to record-low levels.
The Cernavoda nuclear power plant accounts for around 20 per cent of Romania's electricity generation when operating at full capacity.

national_news.title: UAE Vessels Attacked in Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Two UAE vessels were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Iranian attacks, citing a violation of UN Security Council resolution 2817.
The Ministry stressed the importance of freedom of navigation and rejected the targeting of commercial vessels.

national_news.title: Praggnanandhaa Makes Strong Comeback, Defeats Van Foreest
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa secured a convincing victory over Dutch player Jorden Van Foreest in the fourth round of the Sinquefield Cup.
The win took Praggnanandhaa's tally to two-and-a-half points from four games, placing him in a share of second position in the 10-player, nine-round tournament.
Praggnanandhaa's latest victory will boost his confidence and strengthen his bid for a podium finish.

national_news.title: India wins 35 medals, including 13 gold, at Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India emerged as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The Indian contingent secured thirteen gold, eight silver, and fourteen bronze medals at the event.
Senior Indian fencers claimed five gold medals in six events on the fourth and final day of the competition.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July this year.
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier.
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, engineering goods, and organic and inorganic chemicals.

national_news.title: President approves 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) & 89 Mention-in-Despatches on the eve of 80th Independence Day
bullets: President Smt Droupadi Murmu approved 78 Gallantry awards, including 13 posthumous, to Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces personnel.
The awards include 09 Kirti Chakras, 01 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 19 Shaurya Chakras, 05 Bars to Sena Medals (Gallantry), and 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry).
These awards were given on the eve of 80th Independence Day 2026.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurates Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk as part of nationwide patriotic campaign
bullets: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurated the Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk at the India Habitat Centre (IHC), New Delhi.
The inauguration was part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign being observed.
The campaign aims to promote patriotism and national unity among citizens.

national_news.title: India's Indigenous Rare Earth Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Initiative Gains Momentum
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets.
The initiative aims to strengthen the domestic REPM manufacturing ecosystem and enhance competitiveness in global markets.
The scheme received an overwhelming response, with 20 bids received through a global tender on the CPP portal.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Report on Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub
bullets: NITI Aayog released a report titled 'Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub'.
The report aims to strengthen India's manufacturing aspirations and drive the country's growth story.
The report identifies key sectors to position India as a global manufacturing hub, focusing on strategic importance, value chain play, and operational efficiency.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro phase three secures PIB clearance
bullets: The Public Investment Board (PIB) has approved the proposed Phase Three of Ahmedabad Metro.
This development is expected to enhance the city's transportation infrastructure.
The project aims to improve connectivity and reduce travel time for commuters.

national_news.title: Government Reforms to Advance Ease of Doing Business in India
bullets: The government has undertaken reforms to reduce compliance burdens and enhance transparency.
Efforts are being made to advance Ease of Doing Business through digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation processes.
The goal is to create greater opportunities for enterprises of all sizes and encourage entrepreneurship.

national_news.title: MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 - PIB
bullets: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957 governs mining in India.
The Union controls mine regulation for the wider public interest.
The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 aims to bring certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation.

national_news.title: Government Removes 12-Minute Advertisement Duration Cap for Television Channels
bullets: The 12-minute advertisement duration cap for television channels was introduced in 2006 under the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994.
The removal of the cap aims to enable fair competition and ensure ease of doing business in the TV broadcasting sector.
The TV broadcasting sector has undergone significant changes since the introduction of the cap, with the number of TV channels increasing from 62 in 2006 to a much larger number.

national_news.title: Prime Minister emphasizes 'Raksha Shakti' for achieving 'Viksit Bharat' goal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of 'Raksha Shakti' in achieving the goal of 'Viksit Bharat'.
India aims to become a global supplier of next-generation defence technology.
The government is working on Mission Sudarshan Chakra to enhance military capabilities.

national_news.title: Anand Vihar, Udhna Railway Stations To Get Large Passenger Holding Areas Before Festival Rush
bullets: Indian Railways has accelerated work on passenger holding areas at Anand Vihar Terminal and Udhna Railway Station.
The infrastructure upgrade aims to reduce congestion and improve passenger experience during the festival rush.
The new passenger holding areas will provide a more comfortable and safe environment for passengers.

national_news.title: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar awarded Shaurya Chakra for recovering Su-30MKI jet
bullets: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar was awarded the Shaurya Chakra for his bravery in recovering a Su-30MKI jet from a definite crash.
The award is a testament to his exceptional service and dedication to the Indian Air Force.
This achievement highlights the Indian Air Force's commitment to safety and recovery operations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Extends Independence Day Greetings to Citizens
bullets: Bihar CM expressed the importance of remembering the trauma of India's partition.
He emphasized the need for a 'Rashtr Pratham' (Country First) sentiment.
The CM extended Independence Day greetings to the citizens of Bihar.
